first.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ. Memory_91 shows activation messaging improved week-one engagement and first meaningful actions. Memory_86 shows shortened onboarding lifted early adoption. Both directly address the current performance declines. Memory_31 validates that signup simplification works for SMB activation. Activation messaging is the highest-leverage single intervention because it operates within the product for accounts that have already signed up, addressing the downstream engagement gap rather than fighting price competition (which memory_73 warns damages retention) or pursuing referrals (which works for established customers we're trying to retain, not acquire). Enterprise sales assist is inappropriate given the SMB-heavy problem statement. Verifying memory_86 and memory_91 will confirm the magnitude and durability of activation and onboarding effects before committing the week's capacity.
